_comment_: This configuration is for development/testing environments only
_warning: DO NOT use in production - contains example values
_comment_session: Session keys - GENERATE NEW KEYS for your environment
_comment_cors_: Development allows localhost and local IPs
_comment_passwords: Common password file for enhanced security

_usage_instructions.step_1: Generate session keys: go run scripts/generate-session-keys.go
_usage_instructions.step_2: Copy the generated keys to session_signing_key and session_encryption_key above
_usage_instructions.step_3: Adjust CORS origins if needed for your frontend
_usage_instructions.step_4: For TLS in dev, set use_tls to true and provide cert_path/key_path
